summaryZh: Komives Lab 研究非球状蛋白介导的蛋白相互作用。当前体系包括凝血酶与血栓调节蛋白、NFκB、Cullin 5 E3 连接酶及尿激酶与 uPAR，并采用酰胺氢氘交换研究相互作用界面的溶剂可及性。
researchQuestions: 哪些参数支配非球状蛋白介导的蛋白质相互作用？

evidence.quote: Work in the Komives Lab is focused on understanding the parameters that govern protein-protein interactions mediated by non-globular proteins.
We were the first lab to do amide H/D exchange to understand what happens to the solvent accessibility of the protein-protein interface during protein-protein interactions.
The systems currently under study include the thrombin-thrombomodulin interaction, the NFkB signaling system, the Cullin 5 E3 ligases and the urokinase-uPAR interaction.
